description: This file implements a plugin handler for Kubernetes, managing plugin registration, validation, and communication via gRPC, including version checks and event handling.

classes.name: exampleHandler
classes.description: A handler managing plugin validation, registration, deregistration, and event communication.

methods.name: ValidatePlugin
methods.description: Validates plugin name, endpoint, and supported versions, and sends validation event.

methods.name: RegisterPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin, verifies gRPC server readiness, and tests API versions.

methods.name: DeRegisterPlugin
methods.description: Deregisters a plugin and sends deregistration event.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event for a specific plugin via its event channel.

methods.name: DecreasePluginCount
methods.description: Decreases plugin count in expected names map, returning previous count.
